item.title: Example Lab releases open-source reasoning model v2
item.description: Example Lab released version 2 of its open-source reasoning model on Monday. The company said the model is available now for download and can run on a single high-end graphics card. Developers can use the weights under a permissive license. The release includes benchmark results on coding and math tasks. The lab also published an evaluation report describing how the model was tested. Independent researchers have been invited to review the results.
